cards.back:
A group of people who live or work in one place.
Bahasa Indonesia: masyarakat
Example: Our community cleans the park every month.
cards.say: community. A group of people who live or work in one place. Our community cleans the park every month.

cards.back:
A person who lives near you.
Bahasa Indonesia: tetangga
Example: My neighbour waters our plants when we travel.
cards.say: neighbour. A person who lives near you. My neighbour waters our plants when we travel.

cards.back:
The area around your home.
Bahasa Indonesia: lingkungan sekitar
Example: Our neighbourhood is safe and friendly.
cards.say: neighbourhood. The area around your home. Our neighbourhood is safe and friendly.

cards.back:
A person who helps without being paid.
Bahasa Indonesia: sukarelawan
Example: A volunteer read stories to the children.
cards.say: volunteer. A person who helps without being paid. A volunteer read stories to the children.

cards.back:
A person who legally belongs to a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: warga negara
Example: Every citizen should obey the law.
cards.say: citizen. A person who legally belongs to a country. Every citizen should obey the law.

cards.back:
A group of people chosen to make decisions for a town.
Bahasa Indonesia: dewan kota
Example: The council plans to build a new library.
cards.say: council. A group of people chosen to make decisions for a town. The council plans to build a new library.

cards.back:
The leader of a town or city.
Bahasa Indonesia: wali kota
Example: The mayor opened the new bridge.
cards.say: mayor. The leader of a town or city. The mayor opened the new bridge.

cards.back:
A rule made by the government that everyone must follow.
Bahasa Indonesia: hukum
Example: It is the law to wear a helmet on a motorbike.
cards.say: law. A rule made by the government that everyone must follow. It is the law to wear a helmet on a motorbike.

cards.back:
A statement that tells you what you can or cannot do.
Bahasa Indonesia: aturan
Example: The rule says we must line up quietly.
cards.say: rule. A statement that tells you what you can or cannot do. The rule says we must line up quietly.

cards.back:
An organisation that helps people in need.
Bahasa Indonesia: lembaga amal
Example: The charity gave food to families.
cards.say: charity. An organisation that helps people in need. The charity gave food to families.

cards.back:
To give money or things to help others.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyumbang
Example: We donate old clothes to families in need.
cards.say: donate. To give money or things to help others. We donate old clothes to families in need.

cards.back:
A special day or time of celebration.
Bahasa Indonesia: festival
Example: The town festival has music and food stalls.
cards.say: festival. A special day or time of celebration. The town festival has music and food stalls.

cards.back:
To mark a happy day or event with special activities.
Bahasa Indonesia: merayakan
Example: We celebrate Independence Day with a flag ceremony.
cards.say: celebrate. To mark a happy day or event with special activities. We celebrate Independence Day with a flag ceremony.

cards.back:
A custom passed down from older people.
Bahasa Indonesia: tradisi
Example: Eating together at the festival is a family tradition.
cards.say: tradition. A custom passed down from older people. Eating together at the festival is a family tradition.

cards.back:
The way of life, art and beliefs of a group of people.
Bahasa Indonesia: budaya
Example: Indonesia has a rich and colourful culture.
cards.say: culture. The way of life, art and beliefs of a group of people. Indonesia has a rich and colourful culture.

cards.back:
The number of people who live in a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: jumlah penduduk
Example: The population of the city is growing fast.
cards.say: population. The number of people who live in a place. The population of the city is growing fast.

cards.back:
A small place where people live in the countryside.
Bahasa Indonesia: desa
Example: My grandparents live in a small village.
cards.say: village. A small place where people live in the countryside. My grandparents live in a small village.

cards.back:
Relating to a town or city.
Bahasa Indonesia: perkotaan
Example: Urban areas have many buses and shops.
cards.say: urban. Relating to a town or city. Urban areas have many buses and shops.

cards.back:
Open and available to everyone.
Bahasa Indonesia: umum
Example: The public park is open to everyone.
cards.say: public. Open and available to everyone. The public park is open to everyone.

cards.back:
Being protected from danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: keselamatan
Example: Safety rules keep us from harm at school.
cards.say: safety. Being protected from danger. Safety rules keep us from harm at school.

cards.back:
To work together to reach a goal.
Bahasa Indonesia: bekerja sama
Example: We must cooperate to clean the classroom.
cards.say: cooperate. To work together to reach a goal. We must cooperate to clean the classroom.

cards.back:
To treat someone or something with care and honour.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghormati
Example: Children show respect to their elders.
cards.say: respect. To treat someone or something with care and honour. Children show respect to their elders.

cards.back:
To let other people use or have part of something.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbagi
Example: Please share the crayons with your friend.
cards.say: share. To let other people use or have part of something. Please share the crayons with your friend.

cards.back:
The land, air and water around us.
Bahasa Indonesia: lingkungan hidup
Example: We must look after the environment.
cards.say: environment. The land, air and water around us. We must look after the environment.

cards.back:
A building where local people meet for activities.
Bahasa Indonesia: balai warga
Example: The sports club meets at the community centre.
cards.say: community centre. A building where local people meet for activities. The sports club meets at the community centre.
